data.description:
Goal:
Make GitHub enforce legacy, canonical, archive, control, and inbox ref ownership using trusted default-branch Actions and strict rulesets.

Verification:
1. In acartine/knots, enforce disposable-ref rules and prove an ordinary admin credential is rejected while GitHub Actions integration 15368 succeeds.
2. Read back rulesets and verify no repository-role bypass exists on Knots data refs.
3. Run workflow tests and make sanity.

Constraints:
Use the existing GitHub Actions integration, not a new App. Inbox content is data only. Begin with disposable refs and additive archives. Do not delete or rewrite legacy or archive refs.
